Good food, great service, fantastic gym
May 2018 • Solo
I've been training at SSC and eating the food at Lean for Life for a year now - so my review is just a rad overdue!

THE FOOD
Lean for Life food is consistently fresh, delivered on time with a smile. The ingredients are high quality and perfect for the conscious athlete, or simply those who appreciate knowing what goes into their mouths. I'd recommend any of the salmon dishes! 

THE GYM
The facility is state of the art, and hands down the nicest, best equipped gym I've ever seen in APAC. They offer boxing (not boxercise, but there is a separate class if that IS what you're looking for!) in addition to Muay Thai, MMA, Krav Maga PLUS yoga AND crossfit... oh, the gym offers full towel service and to top it all off they have an onsite pool complete with loungers.... RIGHT??

SERVICE
The security, trainers, reception, cleaners, locker ladies, and restaurant staff are at the heart of the gym. I think I can speak for all the expat members that it is the exceptional team behind the big shiny gym that really help to make SSC a home away from home. I have loved being a part of SSC and could not recommend this place more highly. From the recreational athlete to the serious yogi/fighter/lifter - there's a space for you!

Thanks to everyone - keep it up.

Clean, healthy food, with amazing ambience!
Jun 2015 • Friends
I am compelled to write a review. After plenty of searching, I’ve finally found this amazing gem tucked away at the heart of HCM. First and foremost, amazing ambiance. There are plenty of seating and unique setups; it can range from high seats and lounge seats. The concept here is inspired by clean and healthy dishes, they offer a determined calorie count for each item listed. My favorite has to be the rotisserie chicken, cooked to absolute perfection, and just consistently good! Nonetheless, they offer many other colorful and clean dishes all in which I cannot wait to try. This outdoor pool setting is a perfect backdrop to enjoy a notable meal; I look forward to coming back!

P.S They also offer a delivery service, but I highly recommend checking out the place for the full experience.
